independent_preflight.limitations: Design only. Provider/stream errors propagate; recovered earlier input does not rebuild later-hour carry-in.

lead_approval.rationale: Root actual-source design case; distinct Astra/xhigh exact-plan PASS89fd28c; fixed10 sufficient, later-progress limit explicit. All prior artifact pins identical and lint0/0 reused.

scope: Forward listed-input completeness refusal only: unavailable/corrupt input is not repaired automatically. Existing catchUp can retry after availability is restored, within its lookback/horizon; historical partial aggregates, late arrivals, partially written shards, event-time manifests, durable producer recovery, online/export/point-read reconciliation and complete retention remain open. Physical caps and explicit truncation unchanged, no served/rendered/viewable or customer policy change. No native/SLO/customer/release claim or commit/push/build/install/deploy/cloud/credential/customer-data/destructive/external operation. Recovery assurance covers retry before later-hour progress; catchUp still continues after failure, so later carry-in/attribution may remain incomplete and is not rebuilt.
